1.web: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
1.asv: I waited patiently for Jehovah; And he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

2.web: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
2.asv: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay; And he set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

3.web: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
3.asv: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: Many shall see it, and fear, And shall trust in Jehovah.

4.web: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
4.asv: Blessed is the man that maketh Jehovah his trust, And respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

5.web: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
5.asv: Many, O Jehovah my God, are the wonderful works which thou hast done, And thy thoughts which are to us-ward: They cannot be set in order unto thee; If I would declare and speak of them, They are more than can be numbered.

6.web: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
6.asv: Sacrifice and offering thou hast no delight in; Mine ears hast thou opened: Burnt-offering and sin-offering hast thou not required.

7.web: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
7.asv: Then said I, Lo, I am come; In the roll of the book it is written of me:

8.web: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
8.asv: I delight to do thy will, O my God; Yea, thy law is within my heart.

9.web: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.
9.asv: I have proclaimed glad tidings of righteousness in the great assembly; Lo, I will not refrain my lips, O Jehovah, thou knowest.

10.web: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
10.asv: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation; I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great assembly.

11.web: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
11.asv: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Jehovah; Let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

12.web: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
12.asv: For innumerable evils have compassed me about; Mine iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; They are more than the hairs of my head; And my heart hath failed me.

13.web: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
13.asv: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me: Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.

14.web: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
14.asv: Let them be put to shame and confounded together That seek after my soul to destroy it: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.

15.web: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
15.asv: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame That say unto me, Aha, aha.

16.web: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”
16.asv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: Let such as love thy salvation say continually, Jehovah be magnified.

17.web: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
17.asv: But I am poor and needy; Yetthe Lord thinketh upon me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; Make no tarrying, O my God.
